correctness.rationale: The set of all 1,048,575 nonzero cubic coefficient masks is exhausted using 12 elementary generators of GL4(F2), giving 141 orbits, independently verified by a 20,160-element Burnside calculation with 2,862,720 total fixed masks including zero. Four affine Groebner unit-ideal tests over F2 certify geometric smoothness for each orbit representative, giving 36 smooth orbits weighted to 322,560 equations. At every rational point, direct symbolic substitution into its tangent plane certifies Q2=0 and squarefree C3 by ad+bc=1, classifying Frobenius line splitting; an independent 258-point rational-line containment calculation confirms all three-rational-line cases. The packaged checker replays these steps and matches 17 coarse and 21 refined strata. Exact finite computations, no extrapolation beyond F2.

value.rationale: Rational Eckardt concurrency and field-of-definition of the three tangent lines are intrinsic contact-geometry invariants of cubic surfaces and are not determined by the established rational-point marginal or 27-line Frobenius permutation alone. The weighted 21-stratum table and its 17-stratum point/count marginal describe natural arithmetic and incidence distinctions, with contrasting N=9 profiles (e=0,1,2,4) and an explicit sharp 7-contact orbit (1,6,0). This is a complete natural classification with reusable arithmetic geometry data, beyond a cosmetic recomputation of known ambient classes.
